title: StatsCapybara: a free, interactive statistics course for visual learners

creators.name: Karsilar, Hakan
creators.affiliation: University College Groningen, University of Groningen

description:
An open, browser-based statistics curriculum: 102 interactive lessons across eight courses in two tracks, alongside 21 tool pages, five long-form guides for thesis students, 71 worked practice problems and nine reproducible practice datasets. Every lesson pairs a written explanation with a canvas visualization the reader can manipulate.

The site is a dependency-free static build with no framework, bundler or package manager, so the published site is its own source. Its statistical routines are guarded by a regression suite of 1,087 assertions, each citing the published source it is checked against, and eight of the nine practice datasets are generated by a committed script from a fixed seed, so they regenerate byte-for-byte and the published worked solutions can be independently confirmed.

Teaching content is licensed CC BY 4.0; the code is licensed MIT. Live at https://statscapybara.com/.
